# telnyx_network_interfaces (Data Source)

The interfaces of a network: WireGuard interfaces, gateways and other attachments.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id id.

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) The interface name to filter on.
- `filter_status` (String) The current status of the interface deployment. One of `created`, `deleting`, `provisioned`, `provisioning`.
- `filter_type` (String) The interface type to filter on.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
